resources.string: Notifications
Needed to show the notifications your automations create, and tap-to-open shortcuts when Android blocks opening apps in the background.
This automation cannot show notifications until notification permission is granted.
Alarms & reminders
Lets time-based automations run exactly on time. Without it, Android may delay them by several minutes to save battery.
Time triggers will still run, but Android may delay them by several minutes.
Modify system settings
Needed to change screen brightness. Android only allows this after you enable it on the system settings screen.
This automation cannot change brightness until \"Modify system settings\" is allowed.
Do Not Disturb access
Needed to turn Do Not Disturb on or off.
This automation cannot change Do Not Disturb until access is granted.
Usage access
Android only tells an app which other app is open if you grant usage access. AutoFlow uses it only to detect the apps you chose as triggers; nothing leaves your device.
\"App opened\" triggers cannot work until usage access is granted.
Location

Needed to detect the places you choose for \"arrive\" / \"leave\" triggers and, by an Android rule, to read the name of your Wi-Fi network. Location stays on the device: AutoFlow never uploads or records a location history.
Place triggers and Wi-Fi network names cannot work until location permission is granted.
Location all the time
Needed so place triggers and Wi-Fi names work while AutoFlow is not on screen. Choose \"Allow all the time\" on the next screen.
Place triggers and specific Wi-Fi networks only work while AutoFlow is open.
Nearby devices
Needed to know which Bluetooth device connected or disconnected.
Bluetooth triggers cannot work until \"Nearby devices\" permission is granted.
Display over other apps
Android blocks apps from opening other apps or screens while in the background. With this permission AutoFlow can open them directly; without it you get a tap-to-open notification instead.
This Android version does not let automation apps open other apps from the background. AutoFlow shows a tap-to-open notification instead.
Apps and links will open through a notification you tap.
